name: enable_hashagg
description: Enables or disables the query planner's use of hash-based aggregation execution plans.
symptoms: Suboptimal query plans for large-group aggregations
Slow GROUP BY queries on large datasets
Increased disk spilling in sort-heavy workloads
tuning_tips: Disable only if hash aggregation consistently produces worse plans than sort-based aggregation for your workload; monitor EXPLAIN output and aggregate query performance before and after change.
